name: Kubernetes Container OOMKilled Remediation
description: Standard diagnostic and mitigation steps for pods crashing due to Out-Of-Memory (OOMKilled) limits.

steps.title: Query Top Memory Consuming Pods
steps.command_template: ContainerMetrics | where Service == '{service}' | top 5 by MemoryUsageMB desc
steps.expected_outcome: Identify specific pod exceeding 95% memory quota.

steps.title: Verify Pod Restart History
steps.expected_outcome: Confirm pod has crashed at least 3 times in the last 60 minutes.

steps.title: Gracefully Restart Crashing Pod
steps.expected_outcome: Kubernetes ReplicaSet spawns fresh pod instance with clean memory footprint.

name: Database Connection Pool Saturation Recovery
description: Remediation playbook for connection starvation and queue timeout spikes.

steps.title: Inspect Active and Idle DB Connections
steps.expected_outcome: Determine whether saturation is caused by hung idle sessions or burst traffic.

steps.title: Identify Top Blocking Queries
steps.command_template: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == 'QueryStoreRuntimeStatistics' | top 5 by TotalDurationMs
steps.expected_outcome: Isolate slow running transactions holding connections open.

steps.title: Terminate Stale Idle Connections
steps.expected_outcome: Free pool slots to allow active transactions to proceed.

name: Canary Deployment Regression Rollback
description: Safely rollback a failing canary release without dropping traffic.

steps.title: Compare Canary vs Baseline Error Rate
steps.command_template: Requests | summarize Canary5xx=countif(Track=='canary' and ResultCode>=500) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
steps.expected_outcome: Verify canary error rate exceeds 5% threshold.

steps.title: Drain Canary Traffic to Baseline
steps.expected_outcome: 100% of user requests routed to stable baseline.

steps.title: Rollback Deployment Revision
steps.expected_outcome: Pods downgraded to previous verified image tag.
